entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: A species of insane Horror-like beings trapped in the Shadows of Rath.

entities.name: Shadows of Rath
entities.description: The extraplanar space between Rath and Dominaria.

entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: A race at war with the Dauthi.

entities.name: Thalakos
entities.description: A neutral race entrapped in the conflict.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane that planeshifted into Dominaria's reach.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane the Dauthi originally lived on.

events.summary: During Rath's planeshift the Dauthi are at war with the Soltari, and all three races are trapped in the Shadows.
events.quote: All three races were caught in the maelstrom of energy that surrounded Rath

events.summary: Trapped incorporeal, the Dauthi lose their sanity.
events.quote: This predicament led the Dauthi to lose their sanity

relations.quote: the Dauthi were at war with the Soltari
